Judges, prosecutors, and police forces in Lancaster, PA are showing us plainly how badly our criminal justice system needs to be overhauled.

Judge Bruce Roth just set bail at $1 million for two more #BlackLivesMatter organizers.

jfc @NPR reporting that police dispersed a #BlackLivesMatter protest “because protesters weren’t adhering to social distancing protocols” as if this were an objective fact / the actual motivation of police and authorities.
